messages:
alex: Hey team — first day! I accepted the org invite but when I try to open any private repo I hit a page that says I need to enable SSO + 2FA. I already turned on 2FA on my account, still blocked. Can't see the `platform` repo I need for my onboarding task. Anyone know the quick steps?

it-bot: Org policy requires SAML SSO + 2FA. If you recently enabled 2FA, you may need to re-authorize the org: https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso :robot_face: 

jamie: welcome @alex! did you accept the invite with your work email or a personal GH account? we usually see weird state when people accept with the wrong account.

alex: accepted with work email. I ran `git config --global user.email` and it's correct. I also clicked "Authorize" on the SSO banner but still 403 on private repos. pasted screenshot in thread.

sara: can you run `gh auth status` and paste output? also check your verified email at https://github.com/settings/emails — GH blocks if email isn't verified.

alex: pasted `gh auth status` output:
```
github.com: Logged in to github.com as alex@redwood (Session active)
  Git operations for github.com: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform (permission: none)
```

mike: thanks — looks like SSO didn't finish linking. I re-sent the org invite and touched your account to add you to `platform` team. Try signing out and back in, then re-accept SSO from the org page: https://github.com/redwood-inference.

alex: re-accepted SSO, tried `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/platform.git` and got `Permission denied (publickey).` I did add my SSH key to GH but maybe wrong key.

devops: provisioning lag sometimes causes a short window where GH shows SSO accepted but permissions not yet synced. I forced a sync for your account and explicitly added you to the `platform` team. Also double-check your SSH key with `ssh -T git@github.com` and ensure the right public key is on your GH account.

alex: ran `ssh -T git@github.com` -> `Hi alex! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.` but clone still failed earlier; retrying now...

alex: Confirmed I can clone now. `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/platform.git` succeeded. Thanks everyone! :tada:

sara: awesome — welcome to the team. For future new-hires: if you get SSO/2FA weirdness, steps are (1) verify email, (2) enable 2FA, (3) sign out & back in, (4) click Authorize on org SSO banner, (5) wait a minute for permission sync.

mike: if your SSH key ever mismatches, add it with `gh ssh-key add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub --title \"work laptop\"` or paste via settings.

alex: saved those notes. Appreciate the quick help — excited to get started on the onboarding checklist.
